subject: TDDR
title: Stage Management
description: Discussion and research into the duties, responsibilities, and roles of a stage manager. Work to include studies in script analysis, communication, rehearsal procedures, performance skills, and style and conceptual approach to theatre. THGE or TDGE 1, THAC or TDAC 1, and THDE or TDDE 1 recommended.

subject: TDDR
title: Advanced Stage Management
description: This course is a further exploration of theory as a guide to practice in the field of stage management and other leadership roles. This class will delve more deeply into many of the topics that are covered in TDDR 101 and will encourage the development of numerous hard and soft skills that are necessary to become a successful stage manager.

subject: TDDR
title: Text Analysis for Actors and Directors
description: An introduction to analyzing text from a director’s point of view as part of a director’s preproduction process. The class will focus on analyzing story, the underlying dramatic structure in terms of dramatic action, narrative vision, and artistic drive.
prerequisites_text: upper-division standing or consent of instructor. Restricted to students within the TH26 major. All other students will be allowed as space permits.

subject: TDDR
title: Directing-Acting Process
description: A studio class that investigates the fundamental skills a director needs to work with actors. Working with actors, students learn how to animate the text onstage through status exercises and scene work as they develop their skill in text work, staging, and dramatic storytelling.
prerequisites_text: TDDR 108 or TDHT 10, upper-division standing or consent of instructor. Restricted to students within the TH26 major. All other students will be allowed as space permits.

subject: TDDR
title: Major Project in Directing
description: For the advanced student in directing. Intensive concentration on the full realization of a dramatic text from research and analysis through rehearsal and into performance. A maximum of eight units of major project study, regardless of area (design, directing, or stage management) may be used to fulfill major requirements. See department for application. May be taken for credit two times.
prerequisites_text: TDDR 108, TDDR 111, consent of instructor, and department stamp.

subject: TDDR
title: Major Project in Stage Management
description: For the advanced student in stage management. Intensive concentration on the full realization of a dramatic text, from research and analysis through rehearsal and final performance. May be taken for credit two times.
prerequisites_text: TDPR 104 and TDDR 101, consent of instructor, and department stamp.
